title: How to allow a custom Desk Theme (Modern_ui_theme) when saving Email Account in ERPNext?

posts.name: Saad Altaf Khan
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

I’m developing a custom app and I want to use a custom Desk Theme called Modern_ui_theme.

By default, Frappe only allows the following desk themes:

  • Light
  • Dark
  • Automatic

What I’ve done so far

  1. Overrode switch_theme method so users can select Modern_ui_theme:
# hooks.py
override_whitelisted_methods = {
    "frappe.core.doctype.user.user.switch_theme": "novasource.override.theme_override.switch_theme"
}

# theme_override.py
import frappe

@frappe.whitelist()
def switch_theme(theme):
    if theme in ["Dark", "Light", "Automatic", "Modern_ui_theme"]:
        frappe.db.set_value("User", frappe.session.user, "desk_theme", theme)

This works fine when switching themes interactively.

  1. User creation and System Settings update also work fine — no validation issues there.

The problem

I only face the following error when saving Email Account setup:

Desk Theme cannot be "Modern_ui_theme". It should be one of "Light", "Dark", "Automatic".

It seems like the Email Account process indirectly validates the desk_theme of the current user.

My Question

Is there a more elegant way to allow "Modern_ui_theme" globally, so that it doesn’t break when saving Email Account?

  • I don’t want to modify Frappe/ERPNext core.
  • I want to keep all other validations intact.
  • Ideally, I’d like to extend the allowed desk themes list in one central place, instead of patching multiple doctypes.
